command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
. (Join-Path $env:REVIEW_SOURCE 'scripts/verify.ps1') -Library
$fixture=$env:REVIEW_FIXTURE
$relative='docs/evidence/G4-M1-FINAL-GATES-001/host-monitor.json'
$target=Join-Path $fixture $relative
$raw=[IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($target)
$results=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new()
function Check-Entrance([string]$name,[string]$expected) {
 $checks=@(Test-Repository -RepositoryRoot $fixture)
 $failures=@($checks | Where-Object Status -eq FAIL)
 if ($expected -eq '') {if ($failures.Count -ne 0) {throw 'clean fixture rejected'}}
 else {if ($failures.Count -ne 1 -or $failures[0].Check -cne 'json' -or -not $failures[0].Message.StartsWith($expected+' ',[StringComparison]::Ordinal)) {throw 'wrong rejection or runner failure'}}
 $results.Add([pscustomobject]@{name=$name;actualFailures=$failures;status='PASS'})
}
Check-Entrance 'original historical bytes accepted' ''
$changed=[byte[]]$raw.Clone()
# Change one digit inside first record, keeping JSONL syntax and text formatting valid.
$text=[Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString($changed)
$offset=$text.IndexOf('G4-M1-FINAL-GATES-001',[StringComparison]::Ordinal)
if ($offset -lt 0) {throw 'mutation target missing'}
$changed[$offset + 18]=[byte][char]'2'
if ([Linq.Enumerable]::SequenceEqual[byte]($raw,$changed)) {throw 'mutation ineffective'}
[IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($target,$changed)
Check-Entrance 'same path exactly one changed byte' $relative
[IO.File]::WriteAllText($target,"{}`n")
Check-Entrance 'same path valid ordinary JSON cannot fallback' $relative
Remove-Item -LiteralPath $target
[IO.File]::WriteAllBytes((Join-Path $fixture 'source.json'),$raw)
Check-Entrance 'other path exact original bytes' 'source.json'
[IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $fixture 'source.json'),"{`"ok`":true}`n")
Check-Entrance 'ordinary valid JSON accepted' ''
$results | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 -Compress

checks.name: same path exactly one changed byte

actualFailures.Message: docs/evidence/G4-M1-FINAL-GATES-001/host-monitor.json 历史JSONL原字节或结构无效

checks.name: same path valid ordinary JSON cannot fallback

actualFailures.Message: docs/evidence/G4-M1-FINAL-GATES-001/host-monitor.json 历史JSONL原字节或结构无效

fixturePreparation: Independent Python TemporaryDirectory: copied 14 required configs, synthetic four AGENTS/PLANS Markdown files; historical bytes from git show exact TestedCommit:path; finally cleanup. REVIEW_SOURCE task tree; REVIEW_FIXTURE isolated directory; PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 NO_COLOR=1.
